resources.string: Place the phone on a known level surface, keep it still, then set zero. The current position will become your reference.
Reading held • tap Release to continue

Place the back of the phone against the surface. X measures left/right tilt; Y measures tilt along the phone. Bubbles move toward the higher side.

Calibrate only against a known level reference. The raised camera housing can tilt the phone: use a flat spacer or a straightedge. Hold freezes the displayed reading. Sound plays once after settling within the selected tolerance. Enabling sound plays a preview. Phone volume buttons adjust media volume; Bluetooth or headphones may receive the sound.

The selected tolerance is an indication threshold, not a guaranteed accuracy. Check the phone by turning it 180° on the same surface. Avoid movement while measuring. Calibration and settings are stored locally. No Internet, ads, or tracking.
Could not play sound. Check media volume and audio output.
